The Solace Standard
Two anchorsMost days carry one primary experience and one secondary detail. The schedule breathes.
Active days come homeAfter hiking, skiing, rafting, fishing, or sky activities, dinner is usually private or at the property.
Quoted after fitVendor costs, dining, rentals, permits, transportation, provisions, florals, and gratuities are separate.

Experience directions, not fixed packages.

This page is meant to sit behind the Luxury menu as additional context. It shows what multi-day coordination can look like without forcing a guest to choose a rigid package. The app request should collect the season, group, pace, interests, budget comfort, property location, and desired level of support.

Curated stay

Light multi-day planning, reservations, one or two activities, arrival prep, and confirmations.
